summary: Renames the order detail view from order_detail to show_order. It also limits the loaded order fields to number and total_cents.

findings.title: Renamed view breaks URL configuration
findings.problem: This change renames order_detail to show_order. The file orders/urls.py line 8 still references views.order_detail.
findings.consequence: Django raises AttributeError when it loads the orders URLconf. Every page in the site then fails, not just order detail.
findings.fix: Keep the original function name. Otherwise update orders/urls.py line 8 to reference views.show_order.
